mapper.select:
SELECT T.CONSTRUCTION_COLUMN COLUMN_NAME, T.CONSTRUCTION_COLUMN, T.parent_material_name_code, T.CHILD_MATERIAL_name_CODE, T.PARAM_CODE, T.source_column, T.sort_code, T.REGULAR_EXPRESSION, T.ERROR_TIPS FROM T_PLM_BOM_CONSTRUCTION_MAPPING T WHERE IS_DELETE = '0' AND CONSTRUCTION_COLUMN NOT IN (
'EMBRYO_CODE', 'EMBRYO_VERSION',
'CLAMPING_PRESSURE', 'CURING_TIME' )

select b.id, b.PARENT_MATERIAL_CODE, b.PARENT_CODE, b.PARENT_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE, b.SAP_VERSION PARENT_MATERIAL_VERSION, b.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE, b.CHILD_CODE, b.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE, b.CHILD_MATERIAL_VERSION, m.SAP_CODE child_Sap_Code, m.Mater_Name CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME, b.DOSAGE, b.UNIT, b.RO_CLASSIFICATION_ATTRS, m.Classification_Attrs, b.AH_COMPONENT_LOCATION, b.DATA_VERSION bom_data_version, m.data_version mat_data_version, b.PRODUCTION_STAGE_CODE from t_mes_bom_info b left join t_mes_material m on b.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE = m.PLM_CODE and b.CHILD_MATERIAL_VERSION = m.Edition_No and m.State = 0 where b.IS_DELETE = 0 and b.status = 0 and b.data_version = 'MES_APS_202503240002' union ALL select m.id, null, null, null, null, m.PLM_CODE, m.mat_spec, m.Mater_type, m.edition_no, m.SAP_CODE, m.mater_name, m.Weight, m.Unit_Name, m.Classification_Attrs, null, m.Mater_type, null, m.data_version, 0 from t_mes_material m where m.Mater_type = 'GT' and m.State = 0 and m.mat_spec and m.PLM_CODE = 'ES3569-01'
mapper.update: UPDATE T_CONSTRUCTION_VERSION_INFO c SET c.del_flag = '1', c.UPDATE_TIME = now() WHERE c.del_flag = '0' AND (c.embryo_code, c.EMBRYO_VERSION) in (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(T.CHILD_CODE, '\w+') EMBRYO_CODE, T.CHILD_MATERIAL_VERSION FROM T_BOM_INFO T WHERE T.Child_Material_Code in (SELECT TT.Child_Material_Code FROM T_MES_BOM_INFO TT WHERE TT.Status = '3' AND TT.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE = 'EMBRYO' AND TT.DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}) AND T.Status = '3' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_BOM_INFO TT WHERE T.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE = TT.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE AND TT.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE = 'EMBRYO' AND T.CHILD_MATERIAL_VERSION = TT.CHILD_MATERIAL_VERSION AND TT.STATUS = '1' ))
